items.title: AI Gateway adds DeepSeek Search and Fetch tools
items.summary: and  are now available through . Search finds relevant pages with titles, URLs, and summaries. Fetch retrieves page content as Markdown for your model to read.DeepSeek SearchDeepSeek FetchAI GatewayUse both tools with any model that supports tool calling, using one AI Gateway API key. No separate DeepSeek account is required, and you can keep the same tools when switching model providers.These helpers are available in AI SDK 6.0.321 and later on v6, or 7.0.160 and later on v7. To combine search and page retrieval, pass both helpers in :pnpm add ai@latestAI_GATEWAY_API_KEYtoolsYou can also use alternative search tools with DeepSeek Fetch if DeepSeek Search fails:Search fallback is model-directed, so provider order and retry limits are best effort. DeepSeek Fetch can retrieve a result URL from any of these search tools.Search and Fetch each cost $0.75 per 1,000 billable requests. Failed requests, timeouts, and empty results have no tool charge.
